name: Haus Maringele
beschreibung:
The Haus Maringele in Nesselwängle is a family-run hotel in the Tannheimer Tal in Tirol.

The quiet location on the edge of the village offers a wide view of the surrounding mountain peaks.

The cozy rooms are furnished with local woods and have a balcony and a private bathroom.

The hotel's own restaurant offers a daily changing evening menu with regional and seasonal dishes.

In the immediate surroundings there are numerous hiking trails for summer activities; in winter, the nearby ski areas allow for downhill runs.

The personal attention from the family and the traditional dining room give the house a cozy atmosphere.
